scripts.check: bun run check:tools && bun run format:check && bun run check:public-surfaces && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:portable && bun run build:portable
scripts.check:tools: set -e; for tool in git go gofmt node tofu terraform; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { printf 'Required portable check tool is missing: %s\n' "$tool" >&2; exit 127; }; done
scripts.check:public-surfaces: bun run check:publication-blockers && bun run check:published-document-lanes && bun run check:public-authority && bun run check:website-snapshot && bun run check:public-snapshot
scripts.check:public-authority: go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance legacy-published-package-check && go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance legacy-admission-evidence-check
scripts.check:public-snapshot: bun scripts/check-public-surfaces.mjs && bun scripts/sync-website-spec.mjs --check && bun test --timeout 30000 scripts/publication-truth.test.mjs scripts/current-authority-boundary.test.mjs scripts/deploy-safety.test.mjs scripts/website-cloudflare-safety.test.mjs scripts/public-schema-manifest.test.mjs scripts/schema-publication-guard.test.mjs scripts/workflow-embedded-node.test.mjs scripts/release-deploy.test.mjs scripts/publication-blockers.test.mjs scripts/site-status.test.mjs scripts/frozen-public-identities.test.mjs
scripts.fmt: gofmt -w . && tofu fmt -recursive examples && tofu fmt -recursive modules
scripts.format:check: set -e; command -v gofmt >/dev/null; unformatted="$(gofmt -l .)"; if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then printf 'The following files need gofmt:\n%s\n' "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi; tofu fmt -check -recursive examples; tofu fmt -check -recursive modules
scripts.lint: go mod verify && go vet ./... && go -C cmd/provider-release mod verify && go -C cmd/provider-release vet ./...
scripts.test:portable: go test ./... && go -C cmd/provider-release test ./... && bun run check:portable-host-v1beta1 && go run ./cmd/portable-host-conformance self-test >/dev/null && go run ./cmd/portable-host-conformance self-test --contract conformance/portable-host-v1beta1 >/dev/null && go run ./cmd/runtime-conformance self-test >/dev/null && go run ./cmd/provider-lifecycle-conformance matrix --opentofu tofu --terraform terraform && go run ./cmd/worker-authoring-conformance matrix --opentofu tofu --terraform terraform && go run ./cmd/form-package conformance && bun run check:current-form-candidates && bun run check:current-form-families && go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance verify && go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance release-plan && go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance current-release-plan >/dev/null && go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance candidate-publication-check && go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance published-package-check && go run ./cmd/standard-form-conformance retained-ga-core-v1-published-package-check
scripts.build:portable: set -e; build_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$build_dir"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$build_dir/root"; go build -o "$build_dir/root/" ./...; go -C cmd/provider-release build -o "$build_dir/provider-release" .
scripts.check:release-owner-gate: bun run check:tools && bun run format:check && bun run check:publication-authority && bun run check:public-snapshot && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:portable && bun run build:portable
